project.name: KImageFormats OraHandler (saved crash in Qt/libpng/zlib warning path)
project.fixed_commit_note: The recorded `fixed_commit` only replaces `QLatin1String` with `QStringLiteral` in `src/imageformats/ora.cpp` and `kra.cpp`. The staged `patch.diff` in this result directory is a mismatched artifact for OSS-Fuzz #14446 in `src/imageformats/rgb.cpp`. Neither artifact touches `src/kimageformats/src/imageformats/ora.cpp:46`, Qt's `qpnghandler.cpp`, bundled libpng's IDAT warning path, or zlib `inflate()`, so none demonstrates remediation for this saved crash path.

analysis_state.reason: Stage 01 reproduced the saved MSAN crash on the `OraHandler -> Qt/libpng warning -> QString::fromUtf8` path. The exact staged source and saved stack now close the warning side of that path: `png_read_row` calls `png_read_IDAT_data(png_ptr, png_ptr->row_buf, row_info.rowbytes + 1)`, so the crashing invocation has `output != NULL` and the only reachable benign-warning producer is the `png_chunk_benign_error(png_ptr, "Extra compressed data")` branch at `pngrutil.c:4244-4245`. `png_chunk_warning` then formats a chunk-prefixed stack buffer from that literal, `png_warning` forwards it unchanged to `qt_png_warning`, and Qt's `%s` formatter reaches the saved sink `QString::fromUtf8` / `strlen`. The saved `strlen` region size (28 bytes) is consistent with `"IDAT: Extra compressed data\0"`. The MSAN origin separately names stack storage `hbuf` in `inflate()`, but the allocation stack stops at `inflate()` and the staged source does not show any source-level copy, alias, or transformation from `hbuf` into the formatted warning buffer or the `%s` argument. Stage 02 therefore grounds the warning path and sink but cannot close a project-side origin-to-sink propagation.

bug_description.original_source: ARVO-Meta.report.comments[0].content / staged vulnerable source / saved sanitizer trace / passive `file` and `zipinfo -v` inspection of `poc`
bug_description.normalized: Stage 01 reproduced `MemorySanitizer: use-of-uninitialized-value` while `OraHandler::read()` decoded the staged malformed ORA-like witness through Qt's PNG loader. `OraHandler` resolves the archive member `mergedimage.png`, `KZipFileEntry::data()` materializes that deflated member's uncompressed bytes, and `image->loadFromData(..., "PNG")` forces the Qt/libpng IDAT decode path. The saved stack and exact staged source show that the crashing `png_read_IDAT_data` invocation comes from `png_read_row`, which passes non-NULL `png_ptr->row_buf` as `output`; therefore the checking-only benign-warning arm using `png_ptr->zstream.msg` is impossible here, and the only reachable benign-warning producer is `png_chunk_benign_error(png_ptr, "Extra compressed data")` after `Z_STREAM_END` with leftover compressed bytes. `png_chunk_warning` formats a chunk-prefixed stack buffer from that literal, `png_warning` forwards the same buffer to `qt_png_warning`, and Qt's `%s` path reaches `QString::vasprintf` line 7175 and the saved sink `QString::fromUtf8` / `strlen`. The saved MSAN origin nevertheless points to stack storage `hbuf` in `inflate()`, and the staged source does not show a closed source-level transition from `hbuf` into the formatted warning buffer or the `%s` argument. The recorded `fixed_commit` and staged `patch.diff` are both unrelated to this path.

source.description: First project-side materialization of the exact inner PNG bytes on the witnessed path. `createDevice()` limits the read to the selected ZIP member and, for deflated members, wraps it in a decompression device, so `arr` becomes the uncompressed `mergedimage.png` contents later handed to Qt.
source.value_from: Passive `zipinfo -v` inspection shows the staged `poc` is a malformed ZIP-like archive whose central directory still lists a deflated `mergedimage.png` entry (#6). This line is the first project statement that materializes that member's bytes for the saved crash path.
source.note: The saved run reached `OraHandler::read()` and then `KZipFileEntry::data()`, so the vulnerability-relevant attacker input here is the inner `mergedimage.png` member, not the outer ZIP container bytes in the raw fuzzer buffer.

tainted_value_origin.description: MSAN origin only. The saved trace attributes the poisoned bytes to stack allocation `hbuf` in `inflate()`. In the staged source, `CRC2` writes only `hbuf[0..1]` and `CRC4` writes `hbuf[0..3]` during gzip-header CRC bookkeeping. The saved allocation stack stops at `inflate()`, and the staged source does not show a later source-level copy from `hbuf` into the warning buffer produced at root_cause step 8.

sink.description: Exact saved MSAN sink. In `QString::vasprintf`'s `%s` case, Qt passes the libpng warning pointer into `QString::fromUtf8`, which sizes it with `strlen(str)`.
sink.note: Frame 1 in the saved stack is `QString::vasprintf` line 7175 (`subst = QString::fromUtf8(va_arg(ap, const char*))`), and MSAN reports `Uninitialized bytes in __interceptor_strlen at offset 4 inside [..., 28)` at this line.

root_cause.description: Exact source-level producer of the warning C string later consumed at the sink. `png_chunk_warning` formats stack buffer `msg` from the current chunk name and the selected warning text before passing that buffer onward through the installed warning callback.
root_cause.note: On this saved stack the selected warning text is the literal `"Extra compressed data"`, not `png_ptr->zstream.msg`, because `png_read_row` passed non-NULL `output`. This step closes the warning-side value creation that reaches Qt, but it does not explain the separate MSAN origin in `inflate::hbuf`.

parser_admitted.description: The harness calls `OraHandler::read()` regardless of `canRead()`. On the witnessed path `zip.open(...)` succeeds and `zip.directory()->entry("mergedimage.png")` returns a file entry, so `KZipFileEntry::data()` materializes that member and reaches the downstream PNG decode path.

evidence_limitations: The saved allocation stack stops at `inflate()` and does not identify the higher-level caller that allocated `hbuf`, so Stage 02 cannot place the MSAN origin on a specific source-level inflate invocation from the staged artifacts alone.

After the stack-consistent warning side is fixed to `png_chunk_benign_error(png_ptr, "Extra compressed data")`, the staged source only shows `png_chunk_warning` building a chunk-prefixed stack buffer and `png_warning` / `qt_png_warning` forwarding it to Qt. It does not show a source-level copy, alias, or transformation from `inflate::hbuf` into that buffer or the `%s` argument later consumed at the sink.

The recorded `fixed_commit` and the staged `patch.diff` are unrelated to this path: the commit only swaps `QLatin1String` for `QStringLiteral` in `ora.cpp` and `kra.cpp`, and the diff is for OSS-Fuzz #14446 in `src/imageformats/rgb.cpp`.
`run_flags.json` sets `runtime_disambiguation` to `false`, so Stage 02 may not instrument the ARVO workspace to observe which bytes actually carried the saved `inflate::hbuf` origin into the sink.

coarse_trace.summary: KArchive materializes the deflated `mergedimage.png` member from the malformed ORA-like witness.
OraHandler forwards those bytes to `QImage::loadFromData(..., "PNG")`, forcing the downstream Qt PNG decoder.
Qt installs `qt_png_warning` on a libpng read struct whose benign read errors are configured to warn rather than abort.

The crashing `png_read_IDAT_data` call uses non-NULL `png_ptr->row_buf` as `output`, which removes the impossible checking-only warning arm and pins the benign warning to the literal `"Extra compressed data"` branch.
Libpng formats a chunk-prefixed warning buffer from that literal and forwards it through `png_warning` and `qt_png_warning` into Qt's `%s` logging path.
Qt sizes the warning C string with `strlen(str)` at the saved sink, but the separate MSAN origin in `inflate::hbuf` remains unclosed from source alone.

fine_trace.note: Reads the selected ZIP member through the member-limited device returned by `createDevice()`. For deflated entries this yields the uncompressed `mergedimage.png` byte stream later parsed by Qt.
OraHandler forwards the member bytes from step 1 into Qt and explicitly forces PNG dispatch with the format string `"PNG"`.

Libpng read structs default benign read errors to warnings. This state matters because the later leftover-data condition flows into `png_chunk_warning` instead of taking the fatal `png_chunk_error` path.
Qt installs `qt_png_warning` as libpng's warning callback for this decode, so benign libpng warnings are routed into `qWarning("libpng warning: %s", ...)`.

The crashing invocation passes non-NULL `png_ptr->row_buf` as `output`. That fixes the call context: the checking-only benign-warning arm `png_chunk_benign_error(png_ptr, png_ptr->zstream.msg)` at `pngrutil.c:4256-4258` is impossible on this stack.

The saved stack reaches `png_chunk_benign_error` from this `png_read_IDAT_data` call, and step 5 proves `output != NULL`, so the only stack-consistent benign-warning producer is this leftover-compressed-data branch with the literal warning text `"Extra compressed data"`.
Because step 3 set `PNG_FLAG_BENIGN_ERRORS_WARN`, libpng forwards the literal from step 6 to `png_chunk_warning` rather than taking the fatal `png_chunk_error` path.

Builds the stack buffer later logged by Qt. `png_format_buffer` prepends the current chunk name and `": "` to `warning_message`; while reading IDAT data, `png_read_chunk_header()` stores `png_ptr->chunk_name` and `png_read_IDAT_data` rejects non-IDAT chunks, so this buffer is consistent with `"IDAT: Extra compressed data"`. That string is 27 bytes plus NUL, matching the saved 28-byte `strlen` region. The staged source still does not show how the separate `inflate::hbuf` origin poisons any byte of this buffer.
For this warning string `offset` stays 0 because the message does not start with `'#'`, so `png_warning` forwards the same `msg` pointer from step 8 unchanged to the installed callback.
Passes the forwarded libpng warning pointer as the `%s` argument to Qt's logging formatter. This is the last project-side call before Qt consumes the string in `QString::vasprintf`.
In the `%s` case, Qt extracts the `message` vararg supplied at step 10 and calls `QString::fromUtf8` on that exact C-string pointer.
MSAN sink. `fromUtf8` sizes the `%s` argument with `strlen(str)`, and the saved run reports uninitialized bytes at offset 4 inside a 28-byte read at this line.

allocation_context.note: The saved trace says the uninitialized value was created by an allocation of `hbuf` in the stack frame of `inflate`; the actual `hbuf` declaration is line 640 in the exact staged source, and the saved allocation stack does not include a higher-level caller.

cross_validation.root_cause_matches_allocation_context: No. The saved allocation context is `inflate::hbuf`, while the exact source-grounded warning buffer at step 8 is built from the current chunk name and the literal `"Extra compressed data"`. The staged source does not expose a source-level transition between them.
cross_validation.trace_consistent_with_stack: Yes. The saved stack `OraHandler::read -> QImage::loadFromData -> QImageReader::read -> QPngHandler::read -> QPngHandlerPrivate::readPngImage -> png_read_image -> png_read_row -> png_read_IDAT_data -> png_chunk_benign_error -> qt_png_warning -> QMessageLogger::warning -> qt_message -> QString::vasprintf -> QString::fromUtf8` is reflected by fine-trace steps 1-12. Step 5 fixes the `png_read_IDAT_data` call context to `output != NULL`, step 6 fixes the benign warning to the literal `"Extra compressed data"`, and steps 8-12 follow the resulting warning buffer into the sink.
cross_validation.tainted_value_reaches_sink: Unresolved. The source-grounded warning buffer from step 8 reaches the sink, but the staged artifacts do not expose any source-level transition that carries the saved `inflate::hbuf` origin into that buffer or into the `%s` argument consumed by `QString::fromUtf8`.
cross_validation.patch_resolves_note: The staged `patch.diff` is a mismatched `rgb.cpp` fix for OSS-Fuzz #14446, and the recorded `fixed_commit` only changes `QLatin1String` to `QStringLiteral` in `ora.cpp` and `kra.cpp`. Neither artifact demonstrates remediation for this crash path.

poc.trigger: Stage 01 reproduced the crash by running `PYTHONPATH=gt_generation python3 -m gt_toolkit arvo-workspace --result-dir /mnt/datastore/gt_generation/gt_results/arvo_14322 run --version vulnerable --expect crash`. On the saved vulnerable run, `OraHandler::read()` opened the staged malformed ORA-like archive, resolved `mergedimage.png`, materialized that member with `KZipFileEntry::data()`, and forced PNG decoding with `image->loadFromData(..., "PNG")`. The saved stack and staged source pin the warning side to `png_read_row -> png_read_IDAT_data(..., png_ptr->row_buf, ...)`, whose only reachable benign-warning site on this call is `png_chunk_benign_error(png_ptr, "Extra compressed data")`; Qt then logs that warning through `%s` and MSAN fires in `QString::fromUtf8`.

format.name: exact staged malformed ORA-like ZIP witness
format.contract: The available evidence establishes only the exact staged `poc`: a malformed ZIP / ORA-like archive that `KZip` opens and whose central directory still exposes a deflated `mergedimage.png` member. Passive `zipinfo -v` inspection reports a central-directory length mismatch (`61 bytes too long`) but still lists `mergedimage.png` as entry #6. On the witnessed path, materializing that member and forcing `image->loadFromData(..., "PNG")` reaches `png_read_row -> png_read_IDAT_data -> png_chunk_benign_error(..., "Extra compressed data") -> qt_png_warning` and the saved MSAN sink. Because the harness calls `OraHandler::read()` regardless of `canRead()`, Stage 02 cannot generalize beyond this exact witness behavior.
